kinds.label: Chat agent
kinds.summary: The agent people chat with: what it's told, its model, what it can call and who it hands off to.
kinds.keywords: chat agent llm root assistant bot

kinds.label: Sub-agent
kinds.summary: Another LLM agent: it takes over when handed off to, does a task and hands back, or is a tool the agent calls.
kinds.keywords: sub agent specialist delegate transfer hand off llm

kinds.label: Intake agent
kinds.summary: Walks the person through an intake you design: it collects a record in whatever order they give it, then hands it back to the agent that handed off.
kinds.keywords: intake form questionnaire collect record onboarding slot filling fields task hand off

kinds.label: Saved agent
kinds.summary: Another of the organization's agents, whole: handed off to, or called as a tool.

kinds.label: Memory
kinds.summary: Recalls what was said in earlier conversations with the same person.
kinds.keywords: memory remember recall history past conversations

kinds.label: Knowledge base
kinds.summary: Searches the organization's knowledge bases: the documents uploaded to them, by meaning and by their words.
kinds.keywords: knowledge base documents rag retrieval search vector embeddings files pdf

kinds.label: HTTP tool
kinds.summary: Calls an HTTP endpoint with arguments the model fills in.
kinds.keywords: http api rest request endpoint function tool webhook

kinds.label: OpenAPI
kinds.summary: The operations of an OpenAPI spec, each a tool.
kinds.keywords: openapi swagger spec api rest operations

kinds.label: MCP server
kinds.summary: The tools of a remote MCP server: one of the organization's, or one by URL.
kinds.keywords: mcp model context protocol server tools remote oauth

kinds.label: Workflow
kinds.summary: One of the organization's workflows, as a tool: the agent runs it with its input and gets its result.
kinds.keywords: adk workflow graph tool run process

kinds.label: Code execution
kinds.summary: Runs Python the model writes, to calculate or transform data, and answers with what it printed.
kinds.keywords: code execution python run script calculate interpreter sandbox

kinds.label: Skills
kinds.summary: Skills from the organization's vault: instructions and files the agent loads when a task calls for one.
kinds.keywords: skills skill vault instructions playbook procedure how-to know-how SKILL.md

kinds.label: Rich answers
kinds.summary: Lets the agent answer with cards, key figures, tables, charts and steps the chat draws beside its text, and choices the person clicks to reply.
kinds.keywords: rich answers generative ui present cards charts graphs tables facts figures steps choices buttons options visual layout
